titleEn: Largest Component Size by Common Factor
title: 按公因数计算最大组件大小
summary: 数组元素是图节点，两个数有大于一的公因数时相连，求最大连通分量大小。
insight: 对每个数分解不同质因数；同一质因数首次出现的元素作为代表，之后出现的元素与代表合并，传递关系由并查集维护。
pitfalls: 一个质因数在同一数字中只处理一次
分解结束剩余大于一的数也是质因数
并查集统计的是数组下标而非数值

solutions.title: 质因数代表并查集
solutions.idea: 通过共享质因数合并元素下标。
steps: 初始化下标并查集与 factor->index 映射
对 nums[i] 试除质因数；每个因数若已有代表则合并，否则记录 i，并除尽该因数
处理最终剩余质因数；统计每个根的节点数并取最大

code.java: class Solution { public int largestComponentSize(int[] nums){int n=nums.length;int[] parent=new int[n],size=new int[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++){parent[i]=i;size[i]=1;}Map<Integer,Integer> owner=new HashMap<>();for(int i=0;i<n;i++){int value=nums[i];for(int factor=2;factor*factor<=value;factor++)if(value%factor==0){connect(factor,i,owner,parent,size);while(value%factor==0)value/=factor;}if(value>1)connect(value,i,owner,parent,size);}int answer=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)if(find(i,parent)==i)answer=Math.max(answer,size[i]);return answer;}private void connect(int factor,int i,Map<Integer,Integer> owner,int[] p,int[] s){Integer other=owner.putIfAbsent(factor,i);if(other!=null)union(i,other,p,s);}private int find(int x,int[] p){return p[x]==x?x:(p[x]=find(p[x],p));}private void union(int a,int b,int[] p,int[] s){a=find(a,p);b=find(b,p);if(a==b)return;if(s[a]<s[b]){int t=a;a=b;b=t;}p[b]=a;s[a]+=s[b];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun largestComponentSize(nums:IntArray):Int{val parent=IntArray(nums.size){it};val size=IntArray(nums.size){1};fun find(xInput:Int):Int{var x=xInput;while(parent[x]!=x){parent[x]=parent[parent[x]];x=parent[x]};return x};fun union(aInput:Int,bInput:Int){var a=find(aInput);var b=find(bInput);if(a==b)return;if(size[a]<size[b]){val t=a;a=b;b=t};parent[b]=a;size[a]+=size[b]};val owner=mutableMapOf<Int,Int>();fun connect(factor:Int,index:Int){val other=owner.putIfAbsent(factor,index);if(other!=null)union(index,other)};for(i in nums.indices){var value=nums[i];var factor=2;while(factor*factor<=value){if(value%factor==0){connect(factor,i);while(value%factor==0)value/=factor};factor++};if(value>1)connect(value,i)};return nums.indices.filter{find(it)==it}.maxOf{size[it]}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<int> parent,size;int find(int x){return parent[x]==x?x:parent[x]=find(parent[x]);}void unite(int a,int b){a=find(a);b=find(b);if(a==b)return;if(size[a]<size[b])swap(a,b);parent[b]=a;size[a]+=size[b];}public:int largestComponentSize(vector<int>& nums){int n=nums.size();parent.resize(n);iota(parent.begin(),parent.end(),0);size.assign(n,1);unordered_map<int,int> owner;auto connect=[&](int factor,int index){if(owner.count(factor))unite(index,owner[factor]);else owner[factor]=index;};for(int i=0;i<n;++i){int value=nums[i];for(int factor=2;factor*factor<=value;++factor)if(value%factor==0){connect(factor,i);while(value%factor==0)value/=factor;}if(value>1)connect(value,i);}int answer=0;for(int i=0;i<n;++i)if(find(i)==i)answer=max(answer,size[i]);return answer;} };
